title: StoreOutcomeUnknown payload
description: EKR could not say whether a store write of the run took effect (`ekr stage begin`, `ekr stage publish`, `ekr apply-extraction` or the settling of an earlier run's stage answered that the publication outcome is unknown). Nothing about the source was wrong; the next run settles the stage, or extracts the batch again. For `cortex schema`, the write is a proposal's schema transaction (`ekr commit`) or the stage of `cortex schema apply`; the reason names it.
